name: holotype-mind-worker
description: Holotype MIND worker: Holo's LLM cognition as a standalone Cloudflare Worker, physically separate from the murmur-fork BODY worker. Cron heartbeat observes the body's neural state, asks an LLM (paid per-call in USDC via BlockRun x402) for a narration + intent, a deterministic policy gate decides, and the result is written to an isolated encrypted D1 store. Holds the wallet/master-key/creator-token secrets so the body worker stays keyless and moneyless.
